path.title: directory to scan
path.description: Absolute or relative path of the directory to walk. Defaults to `defaultRoot` in this module's device config, which the operator sets (`npm run demo:repo-review` sets it to the countinghouse checkout); with none, path is required. A filesystem root is refused. Under --moduleSandbox audit, reads outside the module are allowed and logged; enforce with a declared fs permission is what confines them.

include.title: include globs
include.description: Glob patterns a repository-relative path must match to be read. Supports *, ?, ** and {a,b} alternation. Defaults to source and manifest files.

exclude.title: exclude globs
exclude.description: Glob patterns that veto a path even when it matched an include pattern. Defaults to node_modules, .git, build output and binary assets.

maxBytes.title: byte budget
maxBytes.description: Stop reading once this many bytes of file content have been collected, and mark the result truncated.

maxFiles.title: file budget
maxFiles.description: Stop reading once this many files have been collected, and mark the result truncated.

byteCount.title: total bytes of file content actually read

truncated.title: whether a budget stopped the walk early

truncationReason.title: which budget stopped the walk, or null
